QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

Before we begin.

Do you handle the script?+

Scripting and storyboarding can be included. We agree the information, reviews and subject-matter input needed from your team.

Animation or live action?+

The right format depends on the message, available assets, audience and budget. We work through that choice in the brief.

Can you use existing footage?+

Yes, subject to quality, format and usage rights. We review existing material before committing to the edit.

Can we get different versions?+

Yes. Aspect ratios, cutdowns, languages and captions are scoped before production so delivery matches the channels.

How are revisions handled?+

Review stages and revision rounds are agreed in the proposal, with script and visual direction resolved before the most production-intensive work.
